outcome: Postoperative gastrointestinal function (time to flatus and stool passage)
cohort: 60 patients undergoing elective cesarean section under general anesthesia
finding: Intraoperative abdominal irrigation with saline did not significantly affect postoperative gastrointestinal function, short-term maternal morbidity, or pain scores in patients undergoing cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study investigated the effects of intraabdominal irrigation with saline on postoperative gastrointestinal function in patients who underwent cesarean section.
